name: ground_truth_MUM-2019-07-02_draft
description: Sourced ground-truth pins for the Mumbai flooding of 1-2 July 2019 (bundle MUM-2019-07-02). Every feature carries source_url and cached_path. depth_cm is null on every feature because no cached source states a numeric depth. Features outside MUM-CENTRAL keep inside_aoi=false so the bundle builder can filter them. Compiled by the VARUNA research team, 2026-09-06.

properties.name: Hindmata flyover / Hindmata junction, Dadar East-Parel
properties.text: BMC deployed de-watering pumps at the low-lying Hindmata flyover; visuals of water on the road below the flyover.
properties.source_title: Mumbai rains LIVE (Deccan Herald live blog, 1-3 Jul 2019)
properties.geocode: OSM node/9739425792 (Hindmata Cinema bus stop); Hindmata Flyover ways 100841069/102170846 lie 19.0055-19.0110, 72.8398-72.8429
properties.note: Blog entry: 'BMC has deployed de-watering equipment at Hindmata flyover. It is a low-lying and is prone to water-logging.'

properties.name: Matunga police station
properties.text: 'Waterlogging at Matunga police station' (Deccan Herald live-blog entry).
properties.source_title: Mumbai rains LIVE (Deccan Herald live blog, 1-3 Jul 2019)
properties.geocode: OSM node/4264457295 (Matunga railway station) used as the anchor; the police station itself is not in the cached geocodes
properties.note: The DH live blog interleaves 1 July and 2 July stamps around this entry; the stamp printed immediately after it is 1 Jul 10:41 IST, hence the +-12 h uncertainty. Do not use this pin for timing verification.

properties.name: Pimpripada, Malad East (compound wall collapse)
properties.text: NDRF: at around 2 am a compound wall in Pimpripada, Malad East collapsed onto hutments. Toll reported as 13 (08:30 IST), 16 (09:55), 18, then 21 dead and 78 injured by 18:40 IST.
properties.source_title: Malad wall collapse death toll rises to 21, 78 injured (LatestLY, 2 Jul 2019 18:40 IST)
properties.note: Outside MUM-CENTRAL (lat 19.179 > 19.135). A fatality event, not a depth observation - keep out of depth verification.

properties.name: Malad subway (two men drowned in a car)
properties.text: Irfan Khan (37) and Gulshad Shaikh (38/40) drowned at about 11.30 pm when their SUV stalled in the flooded subway and its doors jammed.
properties.source_title: Mumbai: two men die as their car drowns in a waterlogged underpass in Malad (Scroll.in, 2 Jul 2019)
properties.geocode: NOT FOUND - Nominatim returned no result for 'Malad Subway, Malad West, Mumbai'; no geometry written
properties.note: Source conflict: Scroll (via NDTV/PTI/Mumbai Mirror) and India TV say Malad subway; the Deccan Herald live blog (2 Jul 12:33 IST) says Milan Subway. Do not place this pin until the location is settled.
